name: B10-0173/2024 (Renew) – Recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament welcomes a plan to update EU guidance on smoke- and aerosol-free spaces. It asks member states to ban smoking, e-cigarettes and heated tobacco products in more public places, including outdoor cafés, playgrounds, transport stops and areas near hospitals and schools. It wants extra protection for children, young people and pregnant women, more research on second-hand aerosol risks, and action against illegal vaping products. The Parliament is giving its opinion; the actual recommendation comes from the Council.

- Member states are urged to extend smoking and vaping bans to more indoor and outdoor public places.
- Children, young people, pregnant women and bystanders would get more protection from smoke and aerosols.
- The Commission should report back in four years on how the recommendation is being applied.
